qe: What was the primary motive behind the introduction of 'Plantation Agriculture' by European colonial powers?
qh: यूरोपीय लोगों द्वारा शुरू की गई 'रोपण कृषि' (Plantation Agriculture) के पीछे प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या था?
o: Commercial profit, supply of raw materials, and international export
Free food distribution for local populations
e: Concept: Plantation agriculture ek aisi badi kheti hai jisme kisi ek cash crop (chai, coffee, rubber, ganna, kela) ko bade estate par ugaya jata hai, aur paisa lagane wale (capital) videshi company hoti thi. Colonial powers (British, French, Dutch) ka mukhya maksad tha - zyada munafa, apni industries ke liye sasta kachcha maal, aur videsh me bech kar export income. Isliye ismein jaada makkad (profit + raw material + export) teeno shamil the. Forest conservation ya muft khana baantna iska maksad nahi tha. Exam point: 'Plantation = cash crop + export + colonial profit'.

qe: Which of the following is a key characteristic of 'Extensive Commercial Grain Cultivation'?
qh: 'विस्तृत वाणिज्यिक अनाज कृषि' की निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी एक प्रमुख विशेषता है?
o: Exclusive reliance on intensive manual labor
Large farm holdings, high total output, and high yield per worker despite low yield per unit area
e: Concept: Extensive commercial grain cultivation ka matlab hai bahut badi zameenon par anaj ki kheti, jahan machinery (tractor, harvester) ka use zyada aur mazdoor kam hote hain - jaise North America ke Prairies, Russia ke Steppes. 'Extensive' ka matlab hai kam mehnat per hectare par zyada zameen; isliye per hectare paidavar kam hoti hai par HAR MAZDOOR ki paidavar bahut zyada hoti hai (kyunki ek mazdoor hazaaron acre sambhalta hai). Chhote tukdon aur zyada manual labour wale options iske ulta (intensive) hain. Exam point: 'Extensive grain farming = badi farms + machinery + high output per worker'.

qe: What is the defining structural feature of 'Mixed Farming'?
qh: 'मिश्रित कृषि' (Mixed Farming) को क्या परिभाषित करता है?
o: Equal integration of arable crop cultivation and livestock rearing on the same holding
Combining sand and fertile clay for horticulture
Cultivating only two varieties of grain together
e: Concept: Mixed farming me kisan ek hi khet (holding) par faslon ki kheti aur pashupalan (doodh, murgi, bakri) dono karta hai. Iska fayda ye hai ki aay (income) ka ek hi zariya nahi rehta - fasl kharab hone par dairy se paisa aata hai, aur pashuon se khad milti hai. Isi wajah se ye Europe, North India aur New Zealand me aam hai. 'Mixed' shabd se matlab hai kheti + pashu ka milkar chalna, sirf do anaj ugna nahi. Exam point: 'Mixed farming = crops + livestock ek hi farm par'.

qe: Which branch of animal husbandry is the most advanced, highly organized, and capital-intensive?
qh: पशुपालन का सबसे उन्नत, सुव्यवस्थित और पूंजी-प्रधान रूप कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Animal husbandry (pashupalan) ki shakhaon me commercial dairy farming sabse advanced hai - ismein khaas nasl ki gaayein/bhains, machine se doodh nikalna, thanda (refrigerated) tank, teeka (veterinary care), aur bazaar ke liye supply chain hoti hai. Isme capital (paisa) aur vaigyanik tarika sabse zyada lagta hai. Nomadic pastoralism aur ranching me ghoomna/khula maidan rehta hai, aur subsistence me sirf ghar ka kharcha nikalta hai. Exam point: 'Sabse advanced aur capital-intensive pashupalan = commercial dairy farming'.

qe: The term 'Truck Farming' is applied to which specialized agricultural enterprise?
qh: 'ट्रक फार्मिंग' (Truck Farming) शब्द का प्रयोग किस विशिष्ट प्रकार की कृषि के लिए किया जाता है?
o: Specialized cultivation of fresh vegetables transported overnight to urban consumer markets
e: Concept: Truck farming (market gardening) me kisan sheher ke aas-paas sabziyan, phal aur phool ugata hai aur raat bhar truck me bhar kar subah mandi me pahuncha deta hai - isliye naam 'truck' pada. Iski sabse badi khaas baat hai: tez kharab hone wali (perishable) cheezein, bade sheher ke paas, aur din-bhar me bik jaana. Iska sabzi ki kheti se hi matlab hai, truck banane ki industry se nahi. Exam point: 'Truck farming = sheher ke liye taaza sabzi (perishable produce) ki kheti'.

qe: Which of the following represents a 'Physical Factor' influencing commercial mining viability?
qh: खनन गतिविधि की व्यवहार्यता को प्रभावित करने वाला 'भौतिक कारक' कौन सा है?
o: Size, concentration grade, and geological depth/mode of occurrence of the mineral deposit
e: Concept: Mining (khanan) shuru karne ke faisle me do tarah ke factor hote hain - physical (prakritik) aur economic (aarthik). Physical factor ye batate hain ki khan khud kitni acchi hai: mineral deposit ka size (kitna bada hai), grade/concentration (usme dhatu kitni hai), aur uski gehrai/tarika (surface par hai ya gehri). Capital, market demand, majdur ki mazdoori, ye sab economic factor hain - khan ke andar nahi, uske aas-paas ke mahaul se jude hain. Exam point: 'Physical factor = deposit ka size, grade, depth (nature of ore body)'.

qe: What characterizes 'Cooperative Farming'?
qh: 'सहकारी कृषि' (Cooperative Farming) की क्या विशेषता है?
o: Voluntary pooling of resources and land by farmers while retaining individual ownership to maximize efficiency
Complete state appropriation of private land
e: Concept: Cooperative farming me kai chhote kisan apni zameen apne paas rakhte hue (ownership apni hi rehti hai) milkar chalte hain - saanjha machine, saanjha beej/khad ki kharid, saanjhi mandi. Isse chhote kheton ka nuksaan kam hota hai aur machinery afford ho pati hai. Isme 'cooperation' voluntary hoti hai, zameen sarkar ke naam nahi hoti. 'Collective farming' (Kolkhoz/USSR) me zameen bhi sanstha (state) ki hoti thi - dono me farq yaad rakhein. Exam point: 'Cooperative = sanjha chalana, apnaam (ownership) apne paas'.

qe: What is meant by 'Factory Farming' in livestock agriculture?
qh: 'फैक्ट्री फार्मिंग' (Factory Farming) का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Rearing poultry and livestock in high-density indoor enclosures with specialized feed and veterinary care
Cultivating hydroponic crops inside industrial factories
Farming conducted exclusively with autonomous robotic machinery
e: Concept: Factory farming aisi pashupalan vidhi hai jisme murgiyan, sauar aur doosre pashu bade bade band (indoor) sheds me ghanabas (high density) me rakhe jate hain, unko khaas tayyar feed (dana), dawa aur teeke diye jate hain, aur climate control hota hai. Iska maksad hai kam jagah me zyada meat/anda/doodh ek hi jaisa (uniform) paida karna. Isme khede (open field) me charna ya robot se sab kuch chalana shamil nahi. Exam point: 'Factory farming = indoor, high-density, feed-based livestock'.

qe: Which economic sector encompasses the direct extraction and harvesting of raw natural resources?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से किसे 'प्राथमिक क्रिया' (Primary Activity) के रूप में परिभाषित किया गया है?
o: Direct extraction of Earth's natural resources (Agriculture, Mining, Forestry, Fishing)
e: Concept: Primary sector (prathmik kshetra) wo activities hain jinme hum seedhe prakriti se cheezein nikaalte hain - kheti (agriculture), mining (khanan), machhli pakdna (fishing) aur jungle se lakdi (forestry). Ye kachcha maal (raw material) dete hain. Manufacturing (gaadi banana) secondary sector hai, banking/services tertiary, aur research/quaternary. Isliye 'direct extraction of natural resources' primary sector ki pehchan hai. Exam point: 'Primary = prakriti se seedha nikalna (kheti, khan, machhli, jungle)'.

qe: What represents the oldest known subsistence economic activity practiced by human civilization?
qh: मानव जाति की सबसे सरल और प्राचीनतम ज्ञात आर्थिक गतिविधि कौन सी है?
e: Concept: Insaan ki sabse purani subsistence (sirf jeevan nirvah wali) activity hunting aur gathering thi - yaani shikar karna aur jungle se phal, kanda-mool, anaj chunna; ye paleolithic (purana pathhar) yug se chali aa rahi hai. Kheti (agriculture) baad me shuru hui, usse pehle insaan sirf nikaalta tha, ugata nahi tha. Mining, dairy farming aur paddy cultivation sab kheti/pashupalan ke baad ki khojein hain. Exam point: 'Sabse purani subsistence activity = hunting & gathering (shikar-shikar aur chunna)'.

qe: Nomadic herding is also formally classified in economic geography as:
qh: 'चलवासी पशुचारण' (Nomadic Herding) को इस नाम से भी जाना जाता है:
e: Concept: Nomadic herding (kabaili/ghoomantu pashupalan) ko economic geography me 'Pastoral Nomadism' kehte hain - isme log apne bakri, bhed, oont, yak ke saath mausam ke hisaab se ghoomte rehte hain, gharon ki jagah dera (tent) hota hai, aur paida kuch zyada tar apne hi khaane ke liye hoti hai. Isko commercial ranching ya mixed farming se alag rakha jata hai kyunki isme zameen ka permanent vaada nahi hota. Exam point: 'Nomadic herding ka shastriya naam = Pastoral Nomadism'.

qe: How does 'Commercial Livestock Rearing' differ fundamentally from 'Nomadic Herding'?
qh: 'वाणिज्यिक पशुधन पालन' 'चलवासी पशुचारण' से कैसे भिन्न है?
o: It is restricted to small subsistence holdings
Animals are moved constantly on foot over thousands of miles
It is highly scientific, capital-intensive, market-oriented, and based on permanent ranches
e: Concept: Commercial livestock rearing (e.g. Australia, USA ke ranches) me pashupalan vaigyanik tarike se hota hai - acchi nasl (breed), teeke aur dawa, khaas charagah, machine se kaam, aur poora dhanda bazaar (bechne) ke liye. Pashu ek jagah tik kar (ranch par) rehte hain; unhe paidal hazaaron kilometre tak nahi hilaya jata - wahi kaam nomadic herding me hota hai. Isliye dono me mukhya farq hai: vaigyanik + capital + market vs sabjanti (subsistence) + ghoomna. Exam point: 'Ranching = scientific, capital-intensive, market-oriented, permanent'.

qe: What are 'Ranches' in the context of commercial pastoralism?
qh: वाणिज्यिक पशुधन पालन के संदर्भ में 'रैंच' (Ranches) क्या हैं?
o: Extensive, permanently fenced grazing estates divided into parcels for rotational grazing
e: Concept: Ranch ek bada open (khula) charagah (grazing estate) hota hai jise baad (fence) se gher kar chhote hisson me baant diya jata hai - har hisse me baari-baari (rotational grazing) pashu charaye jate hain. Isse ghaas dobara ugne ka samay milta hai aur zameen kharab nahi hoti. Ranches commercial livestock rearing ka main dhaancha hai, khaas kar Americas aur Australia me. Mining terraces ya birds ke cage 'ranch' nahi kehlate. Exam point: 'Ranch = fenced bada grazing estate (rotational grazing ke liye hisson me bata)'.

qe: What is 'Transhumance' in pastoral geography?
qh: 'ऋतु-प्रवास' (Transhumance) क्या है?
o: The auction of cattle in commodity exchanges
Seasonal vertical and horizontal migration of pastoralists between mountains and valley plains
Converting pasture lands into sugarcane fields
e: Concept: Transhumance ek khaas aadat hai jisme pashupalak (charwahe) mausam ke saath pohaadon aur ghati (valley) ke beech UPAR-NEECHE aate-jaate hain - garmi me unche charagah (alpine meadows) aur sardi me neeche maidaan. India me Gujjar, Bakarwal aur Gaddi isi tarah ghoomte hain; Alps me bhi yahi hota hai. Isme ek hi jagah ke aas-paas tay (fixed) raste hote hain, bilkul bin raste ghoomna (nomadism) nahi. Bazaar me cattle ki auction isse alag cheez hai. Exam point: 'Transhumance = mausam ke hisaab se pahaad-valley ke beech upar-neeche jaana'.

qe: Which economic sector includes industrial transformation of raw materials into finished consumer goods?
qh: कच्चे माल को मूल्यवान तैयार उत्पादों में बदलने वाली औद्योगिक गतिविधियाँ किस क्षेत्र में आती हैं?
e: Concept: Kachcha maal (raw material) jab factory me ban kar tayyar vastu (finished goods) ban jata hai, to us kaam ko secondary sector ya manufacturing kehte hain - jaise kapas se kapda, loha se gaadi, ganna se cheeni. Yahi section economy ka 'industrial' hissa hai aur isse value add hoti hai. Primary sector (kheti/mining) prakriti se nikaalta hai; tertiary (services) me bank, transport, dukan aate hain; quaternary me research/information. Exam point: 'Raw material se finished goods = Secondary sector (manufacturing)'.

qe: Activities categorized under the 'Quaternary Sector' are primarily centered around:
qh: 'चतुर्थक क्षेत्र' (Quaternary Sector) में मुख्य रूप से किससे संबंधित गतिविधियाँ शामिल हैं?
o: Information collection, production, dissemination, research, and advanced technological consultancy
e: Concept: Quaternary sector (chaturth kshetra) me wo kaam aate hain jinme dimaag aur jaankari (information) lagti hai, koi seepa cheez nahi bante - jaise research & development, data analysis, consultancy, software, education aur scientific research. Ise 'knowledge sector' bhi kehte hain; kyunki aaj ki economy me jaankari ek sachcha punji (capital) hai. Kheti (primary), khanan aur transport alag sectors me aate hain. Exam point: 'Quaternary = knowledge/information/research wala sector'.

qe: In the occupational workforce hierarchy, who are termed 'Gold Collar' professionals?
qh: व्यावसायिक संरचना में 'गोल्ड कॉलर' (Gold Collar) पेशेवर किन्हें कहा जाता है?
o: Highest-level executive decision-makers, policymakers, and scientists in the Quinary sector
e: Concept: Workforce ko collar (gireban ke rang) se pehchaanne ka tarika hai: white collar = office staff, blue collar = factory/mazdoori, pink collar = care work, aur 'gold collar' = sabse upar ke decision-makers (desh ke nitinirdharak, badi company ke CEO, top vaigyanik). Ye quinary sector ka hissa hain kyunki ye aise faisle lete hain jo poori economy ko chalaate hain. Mining karne wale gold collar nahi, blue collar hote hain - naam ka mislead na hona. Exam point: 'Gold collar = sabse upar ke decision makers (quinary sector)'.

qe: What is the primary operational objective governing any 'Commercial' activity?
qh: किसी भी 'वाणिज्यिक' (Commercial) गतिविधि के पीछे प्राथमिक प्रेरक उद्देश्य क्या होता है?
e: Concept: 'Commercial' ka matlab hi hai khaas munafa (profit) ke liye karna aur paisa aage lagane (capital) ko badhana. Iske ulta 'subsistence' hota hai jisme sirf apne ghar ka pet palna hota hai, aur 'philanthropic' me logon ko muft ya saste me dena hota hai. Isliye commercial activity ka asli lakshya profit generation aur capital aage badhana hai, karma ya niyam ki bharpai nahi. FMCG se factory tak, har commercial khet/dukan isi niyam par chalti hai. Exam point: 'Commercial = profit + capital accumulation ka maksad'.

qe: Which demographic age bracket constitutes the economically active 'Working Population' of a nation?
qh: किसी देश की 'कार्यशील जनसंख्या' आमतौर पर किस आयु वर्ग को माना जाता है?
e: Concept: Demography (jansankhya vigyan) me 'working population' (kaam kar sakne wali aabadi) commonly 15 se 59 saal ki umar ko maana jata hai - isse kam badache aur isse zyada buzurg dependent (niranbhar) maane jate hain. Isi hisaab se dependency ratio nikalta hai: kitne log kaam karne walon par nirbhar hain. Isse khel (sports) aur pension yojnayein banane me kaam aata hai. 0-14 aur 60+ wale options dependent aabadi hain. Exam point: 'Working population = 15 se 59 saal'.

qe: What demographic trends does a triangular population pyramid with a broad base signify?
qh: चौड़े आधार वाला 'त्रिकोणीय' जनसंख्या पिरामिड क्या दर्शाता है?
o: A rapidly shrinking and aging population
High birth rates, high infant dependency, and rapid population expansion
Zero population growth with equal birth and death rates
e: Concept: Population pyramid ek graaf hai jo aabadi ko umar aur ling (gender) ke hisaab se dikhata hai. Agar pyramid ka BASE chaura (broad) hai aur upar chhota, to iska matlab hai ki bahut bade bacche paida ho rahe hain (high birth rate), badache ki aabadi jyada hai aur aage aabadi tezi se badhegi - jaise Nigeria, India me pehle. Ulta narrow base hal hi me janm dar ghatne ka ishara hota hai. Exam point: 'Broad base pyramid = high birth rate + rapid growth'.

qe: What does a bell-shaped population pyramid with tapering crest indicate?
qh: 'घंटी के आकार' (Bell-shaped) का जनसंख्या पिरामिड क्या संकेत देता है?
o: A stable population where birth and death rates are balanced and nearly equal
e: Concept: Bell-shaped pyramid (ghanti jaisi) me base na bahut chaura hota hai na patla, aur upar ka hissa sookadta (taper) hua hota hai - iska matlab hai janm aur maut ki dar lagbhag barabar hai, isliye aabadi stabal (sthir) rehti hai. Aisi shakal un daishon me milti hai jahan swasthya sudhar gaya hai aur parivar chhote ho gaye - jaise USA, Australia. Ye 'sthir' taqat (stable) ka lakshan hai, na phatne vali aabadi, na girne vali. Exam point: 'Bell-shaped = stable population (birth = death rate)'.

qe: An 'Urn-shaped' population pyramid with a narrow base and contracted apex characterizes what type of demographic trend?
qh: संकीर्ण आधार वाला 'अर्न-आकार' (कलश जैसा) पिरामिड किस प्रकार की जनसांख्यिकीय प्रवृत्ति को दर्शाता है?
o: A declining or stationary aging population marked by sub-replacement fertility
e: Concept: Urn (matka) jaisi pyramid me base patla (narrow) aur upar ka hissa phaila hua hota hai. Iska matlab: janm ki dar kam (replacement level se bhi neeche) aur buzurgon ki sankhya zyada - yaani aabadi ghumav (shrinking) aur budhapa (aging) ki taraf. Japan aur Germany isi shakal ke udaharan hain, jahan kaam karne wale log kam ho rahe hain aur pension ka bojh badh raha hai. Exam point: 'Urn-shaped = aging + ghatti aabadi (declining population)'.

qe: Why do rural regions in developing nations like India frequently exhibit a higher sex ratio (more females) than industrial urban centers?
qh: भारत जैसे विकासशील देशों में शहरों की तुलना में 'ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों' में महिलाओं का अनुपात अक्सर अधिक क्यों देखा जाता है?
o: Strict urban bans on domestic migration
Government caps on rural female relocation
High availability of tech infrastructure in villages
Male-selective rural-to-urban out-migration for industrial and urban employment
e: Concept: India ke gaon (rural) me shehron se adaadhanak linganupat (sex ratio) zyada hota hai, kyunki gaon se sheher ki taraf zyada tar PURUSH kaam dhunDne jaate hain (male-selective migration). Isse gaon me auratein/behen (females) zyada reh jaati hain aur sheher me males zyada. Isliye sheher ke sex ratio me kami aur gaon me badhotri dikhti hai. Roke ya quota jaisi baatein galat hain, yahaan sirf migration ka asar hai. Exam point: 'Rural sex ratio zyada = purushon ka sheher jaana (male out-migration)'.

qe: What is the standard statistical formula utilized for calculating 'Sex Ratio' in India?
qh: भारत में प्रयुक्त 'लिंग अनुपात' (Sex Ratio) का आधिकारिक सूत्र क्या है?
e: Concept: India me 'sex ratio' ka matlab hai - prati 1000 purushon ke badle kitni striyan (females ki sankhya). Formula: (Female Population / Male Population) x 1000. Yad rakhein, India me denominator hamesha MALE hota hai (1000 males par kitni females), isliye 943 jaisi value aati hai. Doosre deshon me kabhi kabhi ulta ratio (males per females) bhi use hota hai - is wajah se sawal dhyaan se padhein. Exam point: 'Sex ratio = 1000 males par females ki sankhya'.

qe: Which economic sector accounts for the largest share of the workforce in rural developing regions?
qh: विकासशील देशों के 'ग्रामीण' क्षेत्रों में कौन सा क्षेत्र कार्यबल के सबसे बड़े हिस्से को रोजगार देता है?
e: Concept: Vikaasshil (developing) deshon ke gaaon me zyada tar log kheti, pashupalan, jungle aur machhli jaise kaam karte hain, jo sab PRIMARY sector me aate hain - ye seedhe prakriti se cheez nikalne wale kaam hain. Isliye gaon me primary sector hi sabse bada employer hota hai; sheher me manufacturing (secondary) aur services (tertiary) zyada hoti hain. India me abhi bhi lagbhag 45%+ abaadi kheti me lagi hui hai. Exam point: 'Rural workforce ka sabse bada hissa = Primary sector'.

qe: The 'PCPNDT Act' (1994) in India was legislated primarily to eradicate which malpractice?
qh: भारत में 1994 का 'PCPNDT अधिनियम' मुख्य रूप से किस कुप्रथा को समाप्त करने के लिए बनाया गया था?
o: Pre-natal sex determination and female feticide
e: Concept: PCPNDT Act 1994 (Pre-Conception and Pre-Natal Diagnostic Techniques Act) isliye banaya gaya ki koi bhi doctor ya clinic garbh me ladka/ladki ka pata (sex determination) kar ke ladkiyon ka garbhpat (female feticide) na karwa sake. Iska mukhya maksad tha girte hue sex ratio ko rokna aur ladkiyon ko bachana. Ye kanoon clinic ki ultrasound machines par bhi lagu hota hai. Cross-border smuggling ya factor labour se iska koi sambandh nahi. Exam point: 'PCPNDT Act 1994 = pre-natal sex determination aur female feticide rokne ke liye'.

qe: Despite widespread social discrimination, what biological resilience advantage do females exhibit globally?
qh: सामाजिक भेदभावों के बावजूद महिलाओं में कौन सा प्राकृतिक या जैविक लाभ पाया जाता है?
o: Greater genetic and immunological resilience resulting in higher natural longevity
e: Concept: Duniya bhar me auraton ki life expectancy (jine ki umar) purushon se thodi zyada hoti hai, chahe samajik bhedbhav ho. Iski badi vaigyanik wajah hai - do X chromosome (jo genetic galtiyon ki bharpai karte hain), aur immun system (hifazati tantra) ka thoda behtar kaam karna, jisse dhaanth (infection) se ladne ki shamtaa zyada hoti hai. Isliye auraton ki maut dar purushon se kam hoti hai. Total immunity ya muscle density wali baatein galat hain. Exam point: 'Females ki longevity zyada = genetic + immunological resilience'.

qe: What does 'Life Expectancy at Birth' indicate in human development metrics?
qh: मानव विकास सूचकांक में 'जन्म के समय जीवन प्रत्याशा' क्या दर्शाती है?
o: Total annual working hours per employee
The average number of years a newborn infant is expected to live based on current mortality rates
Average age at initial primary school enrollment
e: Concept: 'Life expectancy at birth' batati hai ki agar abhi ki maut ki dar (mortality rates) aise hi chalti rahe, to paida hone wala naya bachcha average kitne SAL kaam zinda rahega. Ye ek 'average/expected' tal hai, kisi khaas vyakti ki umar nahi. Swasthya (health) sudhrne par ye value badh jaati hai, isliye ye kisi desh ke vikaas aur medical suvidhaon ka aham maap (indicator) hai. Working hours ya retirement age isse alag cheezein hain. Exam point: 'Life expectancy at birth = naye bachche ki average umar'.

qe: Why do cities in advanced industrialized nations like Canada and Western Europe have more females than males?
qh: कनाडा और पश्चिमी यूरोप जैसे विकसित देशों के 'शहरी क्षेत्रों' में पुरुषों की तुलना में महिलाएं अधिक क्यों पाई जाती हैं?
o: Farming in rural areas is heavily mechanized and male-dominated, while cities provide abundant service-sector jobs for women
A complete lack of secondary schools in rural provinces
State-mandated residential quotas favoring female urban relocation
Strict legal restrictions preventing women from entering agricultural zones
e: Concept: Canada aur Western Europe jaise advanced daishon me sheher me auratein (females) zyada hoti hain kyunki sheher me service sector (offices, education, health) ki naukriyan zyada hain jinme auratein kaam karti hain, jabki gaon me kheti vaigyanik tarike se machine par chalti hai aur usme zyada tar mard lagte hain (aur kheti me mazdoor (labour) ki zaroorat kam ho gayi hai). Isliye sheher auraton ki taraf khinchte hain. Quota ya rok laga kar nahi - ye economic pull ka asar hai. Exam point: 'Industrial cities me females zyada = service jobs + mechanised rural farming'.

qe: What does the 'Productivity' pillar signify in the Human Development paradigm?
qh: मानव विकास प्रतिमान में 'उत्पादकता' (Productivity) स्तंभ का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Increasing absolute labor hours per working day
Building human capabilities through health, knowledge, and skill development to enhance their economic agency
e: Concept: Human Development (manav vikaas) me 'Productivity' (utpadakta) ka matlab hai - logon ki sehat, shiksha aur kaushal (skill) badha kar unki karyakshta (productivity) badhana, taaki wo zyada kamay kar sakein aur us economy me hissa de sakein. Iska matlab kaam ke ghante badhana nahi - balki insaan KI quality badha kar usse zyada utpadak banana hai. Isi liye HDI me shiksha aur sehat ke indicators hote hain. Exam point: 'Productivity pillar = capabilities badha kar economic agency dena'.

qe: The pioneering Human Development Index (HDI) framework was formulated in 1990 by which two economists?
qh: 1990 में 'मानव विकास सूचकांक' (HDI) की अवधारणा किन दो प्रमुख अर्थशास्त्रियों द्वारा प्रस्तुत की गई थी?
o: John Maynard Keynes and Paul Samuelson
Dr. Mahbub-ul-Haq and Prof. Amartya Sen
e: Concept: Human Development Report (HDR) pehli baar 1990 me UNDP ne Mahbub-ul-Haq (Pakistan ke arthashastri) aur Prof. Amartya Sen (Bharat ke Nobel laureate) ke vichaar se shuru kiya. Dono ne kehte the ki desh ka vikaas sirf GDP se nahi, logon ki sehat, shiksha aur sahuliyat se maapa jana chahiye. Isliye HDI aaya - ek composite index (sehat + shiksha + income). Keynes/Samuelson ya Smith/Ricardo purane arthashastra ke naam hain. Exam point: 'HDI framework (1990) = Mahbub-ul-Haq + Amartya Sen'.

qe: What are the four fundamental pillars of Human Development (SEEP)?
qh: मानव विकास के चार आधारभूत स्तंभ (SEEP) कौन से हैं?
e: Concept: Human development ke chaar stambh hain - SEEP: (1) 'Sustainability' (tikaav, aane wali peedhi ke liye bhi mauka), (2) 'Equity' (sab ke liye barabar mauka), (3) 'Empowerment' (logon ka apne faisle khud lene ki taqat), aur (4) 'Productivity' (kaushal se utpadakta badhana). Ye chaar stambh HDI ke aadhaar hain - sirf income nahi, balki 'logon ki zindagi ki gunvatta (quality of life)' bade. Isliye option (SEEP) hi sahi hai. Exam point: 'Human Development ke 4 stambh = Sustainability, Equity, Empowerment, Productivity'.

qe: In the Human Development framework, what does the 'Equity' pillar mandate?
qh: मानव विकास के संदर्भ में 'समता' (Equity) स्तंभ का क्या तात्पर्य है?
o: Ensuring fair, equal, and non-discriminatory access to opportunities for all individuals irrespective of gender, race, caste, or income
Distributing uniform financial stipends to every citizen
e: Concept: 'Equity' (samta) ka matlab hai ki har vyakti ko mauka (opportunity) barabar mile - chahe wo stree ho ya purush, kaun si jaati, dharam ya kitni aay ho. Iska matlab sab ko bilkul same dena nahi, balki kamzor (vachit) logon ko aage badhne ke liye had se zyada sahayata dena hai. Isliye sahi matlab hai 'bhedbhav bina mauka' - jaise scholarship aur reservation ka aadhaar yahi soch hai. Exam point: 'Equity stambh = barabar, bhedbhav bina mauka'.

qe: Which composite indicator measures human development deficits caused by gender disparity across reproductive health, empowerment, and economic participation?
qh: प्रजनन स्वास्थ्य, सशक्तिकरण और श्रम बाजार में लैंगिक असमानता को मापने वाला समग्र सूचकांक कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Gender Inequality Index (GII) ek composite index hai jo saat (3) ahem cheezon me mahilaon ki sthiti dekhta hai - (1) prajanan svaasthya (maternal mortality + teenage birth), (2) empowerment (parliament me mahilaon ki hissedaari aur shiksha), aur (3) labour market me mahilaon ki bhagidaari (economic participation). Isse pata chalta hai ki gender bhedbhav ki wajah se vikas me kitna nukSaan hua hai. Ye alag index hai; HDI alag. Exam point: 'GII = gender disparity se hone wale vikas ke nukSaan ka maap'.

qe: What does 'Sustainability' mean within the Human Development paradigm?
qh: मानव विकास के संदर्भ में 'सतत पोषणीयता' (Sustainability) का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Preserving current industrial manufacturing quotas indefinitely
Imposing a total cessation of capital goods utilization
Ensuring intergenerational continuity in the availability of resources and human development opportunities
Maintaining an exclusive reliance on renewable biomass
e: Concept: 'Sustainability' ka matlab ye hai ki aaj ke vikas ko aise chalayein ki aane wali peedhiyon ke liye bhi sansadhan aur maukein bache rahein. Yaani pani, jungle, minerals aur svaasthya-shiksha ki suvidhaen khatam nahi honi chahiye; intergenerational continuity (ek peedhi se doosri peedhi tak) bani rahni chahiye. 'Future generations' ka concept hi sustainability ka mool hai, aur isi liye PHDI index planetary pressure (CO2, material footprint) jodta hai. Exam point: 'Sustainability = aane wali peedhi ke liye sansadhan aur mauka bachana'.

qe: The global 'Multidimensional Poverty Index' (MPI) tracks deprivations across which three dimensions?
qh: 'बहुआयामी गरीबी सूचकांक' (MPI) किन तीन प्रमुख आयामों में अभावों का आकलन करता है?
o: Inflation, Housing costs, and Fuel consumption
Health, Education, and Standard of Living
e: Concept: Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) sirf paise (income) ki gareebi nahi dekhta, balki teen bade aayam (dimensions) me kami (deprivation) naapta hai - (1) Swasthya (Sehat: khaana, bachchon ki maut, teeka), (2) Shiksha (Education: saaksharta, school ke saal) aur (3) Jeevan star (Standard of Living: bijli, safai, peene ka paani, ghar ki chhat, fuel, sampatti). Isse pata chalta hai ki ek parivaar kitne tarah se peeche hai - isliye ye UNDP ke HDR me aata hai. Exam point: 'MPI ke 3 aayam = Health, Education, Standard of Living'.

qe: The 'Capability Approach' to welfare economics and human development is pioneered by:
qh: मानव विकास का 'क्षमता दृष्टिकोण' (Capability Approach) किस नोबेल पुरस्कार विजेता से जुड़ा है?
e: Concept: 'Capability Approach' ke pita Prof. Amartya Sen hain. Is vichaar ke mutabiq vikaas ka matlab ye nahi hai ki log kitna kamate hain, balki ye ki logon ke paas kya KARNE-KA-AMAL (capabilities) hai - jaise padhna, swasth rehna, apni pasand chunna, bina darr me jeevan jeevan. Sen ko isi kaam ke liye 1998 ka Nobel (Economics) mila. Isi approach par Human Development Index bhi khada hai. Exam point: 'Capability Approach = Amartya Sen (HDI ka aadhaar)'.

qe: What is the numerical score interval used to express the Human Development Index (HDI)?
qh: 'मानव विकास सूचकांक' (HDI) का मान किस संख्यात्मक पैमाने के बीच मापा जाता है?
e: Concept: Human Development Index (HDI) ki value 0 se 1 ke beech hoti hai - 0 ka matlab sabse kam vikaas aur 1 ka matlab sabse zyada vikaas. Ye teen cheezon ka mila-jula (composite) number hai: umar (life expectancy), shiksha (mean + expected years of schooling) aur income (GNI per capita). Jitna number 1 ke kareeb, utna samriddh vikaas - jaise Norway/Switzerland 0.95+ ke aas-paas. Isliye HDI ka score interval 0 to 1 hi hota hai (kabhi 0-100 nahi). Exam point: 'HDI score 0 se 1 (1 = sabse vikasit)'.

qe: The 'Planetary Pressures-Adjusted Human Development Index' (PHDI) adjusts the standard HDI by accounting for:
qh: 'प्लेनेटरी प्रेशर्स-एडजस्टेड एचडीआई' (PHDI) मानक HDI में किसका समायोजन करता है?
o: Per capita Carbon Dioxide emissions and territorial Material Footprint
e: Concept: PHDI yaani Planetary pressures-adjusted HDI, sabse pehle 2020 me aaya. Ye saamaanya HDI (sehat, shiksha, income) ko us nuksaan se ghatata hai jo desh ne paryavaran ko diya hai - (1) per capita carbon dioxide emissions aur (2) material footprint (khanan-tonna). Matlab: 'vikas ko paryavaran ke saath jodna' - jo desh zyada pradushan deta hai, uski adjusted rank neeche chali jaati hai. Exam point: 'PHDI = HDI minus CO2 emissions + material footprint (paryavaran samayojan)'.

qe: What characterizes the 'Welfare Approach' to human development?
qh: मानव विकास के 'कल्याणकारी दृष्टिकोण' (Welfare Approach) की मुख्य मान्यता क्या है?
o: Humans are treated as passive beneficiaries of government expenditure on education, healthcare, and social security
Taxation is abolished to stimulate industrial hiring
Citizens are viewed as entrepreneurial drivers of state infrastructure
State welfare budgets are eliminated to promote free-market discipline
e: Concept: 'Welfare Approach' (kalyankari drishti) me sarkar ki bhumika aisi maani jati hai ki sarkar yojnayen chalati hai aur logon ko swasthya, shiksha aur sauraksha ki suvidhaen deti hai - log uske 'labharthi/fayda uthane wale' hote hain. Isme insaan ko active kirdaar nahi, passive receiver maana jata hai - isliye isse 'welfare' kehte hain. Iske ulta Sen ka 'capability approach' logon ko apna bhagya khud banane wala maanta hai. Exam point: 'Welfare approach = log sarkar ke faydon ke passive labharthi'.

qe: What does 'Purchasing Power Parity' (PPP) adjust for in international economic comparisons?
qh: 'क्रय शक्ति समानता' (PPP) अंतरराष्ट्रीय आय तुलना में क्या समायोजित करता है?
o: Commercial bank overnight interbank interest rates
Cross-country cost-of-living and price-level variations using a common currency basket
e: Concept: Purchasing Power Parity (PPP) ek aise exchange rate ka aadhaar hai jo ye dekhta hai ki ek hi 'basket' saamaan (khaana, kapda, kira) har desh me kitna mehenga hai. Isse alag deshon ke income (income) ko seedhe na jodh kar unki asli kharid-shakti (purchasing power) ke hisaab se tulna karte hain. Jaise Rs 100 India me kuch zyada kharid leta hai, isliye GDP/GNI per capita ko PPP me badal kar likha jata hai. Ye kisi desh ka currency rate nahi, tulna ka tarika hai. Exam point: 'PPP = kharidne ki samtaa ke hisaab se tulna (cost-of-living adjust)'.

qe: What is the standard demographic formula used to compute 'Population Density'?
qh: 'जनसंख्या घनत्व' (Population Density) की गणना का मानक सूत्र क्या है?
o: Total Population / Total Surface Land Area (persons/km²)
e: Concept: Population density (aabadi ka ghantva) ek simple formula se nikalti hai - total aabadi ko kul bhoomi kshetra (land area) se divide karke, yaani persons per square kilometre (vyakti per km2). Isse pata chalta hai ki kisi ilake me log kitne ghane base hue hain - jaise Bihar ~1100/km2, Australia ~3/km2. Dhyaan do: sirf land area lete hain, paani ka hissa (samudra) nahi jodte. Exam point: 'Density = Population / Land area (persons per km2)'.

qe: Why is demographic age-sex distribution data essential for regional administrators and policy planners?
qh: नीति-निर्माताओं और योजनाकारों के लिए जनसंख्या की आयु-लिंग संरचना जानना क्यों अनिवार्य है?
o: To assess dependency ratios and project future requirements for schools, employment schemes, and geriatric healthcare
To calculate municipal property tax rates exclusively
To regulate seasonal agricultural crop prices
e: Concept: Age-sex (umar-ling) distribution se pata chalta hai ki kis umar me kitne purush aur kitni mahilayen hain. Iska sabse bada fayda ye hai ki 'dependency ratio' (kaam karne walon par nirbhar logo ka bojh) paata chalta hai - jisse sarkar ye tay karti hai ki kitne school (bachchon ke liye), kitni naukri/skill scheme (javanon ke liye) aur kitne hospital/buzurg aashram (budhon ke liye) chahiye. Ye 'future planning' ka aadhaar hai, vote bank nahi. Exam point: 'Age-sex data = dependency ratio + school/jobs/health planning ke liye'.

qe: What is the demographic definition of 'Natural Growth' of population?
qh: जनसंख्या की 'प्राकृतिक वृद्धि' (Natural Growth) की परिभाषा क्या है?
o: Crude Births - Crude Deaths (Net natural increase over a specified time period)
e: Concept: Demography me 'natural growth' ka matlab hai ek saal me paida hone wale bachche (births) minus marne wale log (deaths) - isme bahar se aane-jaane wale (migration) ko nahi jodte. Isliye natural growth = crude birth rate - crude death rate, aur yahi 'net natural increase' kehlata hai. Ye batata hai ki aabadi khud (bina logon ke aane-jaane) kitni badh rahi hai. Total/actual growth me migration bhi jodte hain - dono me farq exam me zaroori hai. Exam point: 'Natural growth = Births - Deaths (migration nahi)'.

qe: Which of the following constitutes an urban 'Pull Factor' in spatial migration?
qh: शहरी क्षेत्रों की ओर प्रवास के लिए निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा एक 'आकर्षण कारक' (Pull Factor) है?
o: Agrarian crop failure and localized drought
Abundant diversified employment, superior healthcare, advanced education, and civic infrastructure
Severe epidemics and lack of potable water
e: Concept: Settlement (basane) shastra me jab log gaon chhodkar sheher ki taraf aate hain to do tarah ke khinchav (push-pull) kaam karte hain. 'Pull factors' wo acchaiyan hain jo sheher kheenchti hain - naukri ke mauke, badiya aspatal, achchi schools aur bijli-pani-sadak. 'Push factors' wo buraiyan hain jo gaon se dhakka deti hain - bhitmool (unemployment), gareebi, kharab suvidhaen, baad-bhood. Isi wajah se Bharat me gaon se sheher ki taraf adhaan (migration) ho rahi hai. Exam point: 'Pull = naukri/aspatal/shiksha; Push = bhookh/gareebi/baadh'.

qe: Which of the following serves as a classic 'Push Factor' driving out-migration from an area of origin?
qh: मूल स्थान छोड़ने के लिए मजबूर करने वाला 'प्रतिकर्ष कारक' (Push Factor) कौन सा है?
o: Persistent rural unemployment, poverty, poor civic services, and environmental disasters
e: Concept: Migration ke 'push factors' wo majbourian hain jo logon ko apna puraana sthaan (origin) chhodne par majboor karti hain - gaon me rozgar (unemployment), gareebi, kharab paani/safai/aspatal, aur prakritik aapda (baadh, sookha, bhukamp). In sab ke kaaran log sheher ki taraf bhaagte hain. Achhi suvidhaen (naukri, aspatal, school) to 'pull factors' hote hain jo kheenchte hain. Dono ka ek hi safar me kaam hota hai - ek dhakka deta, doosra kheenchta. Exam point: 'Push factor = majboori (unemployment, poverty, disaster); Pull = khinchav'.

qe: How is the 'Actual Growth' of population mathematically determined?
qh: जनसंख्या की 'वास्तविक वृद्धि' (Actual Growth) की गणना कैसे की जाती है?
e: Concept: 'Actual growth' ya shesh (total) aabadi vriddhi me sirf paida-hot-maut nahi, balki logon ka aana-jaana (migration) bhi joda jata hai. Formula: (Births - Deaths) + (In-Migration - Out-Migration); yahan pehla hissa 'natural growth' hai aur doosra 'net migration'. Isliye kisi ilake ki aabadi kabhi badh sakti hai chahe wahan janm dar kam ho - kyunki bahar se log aa rahe hain (jaise Gulf ya sheher). Exam point: 'Actual growth = (B-D) + (I-O)'.

qe: What demographic condition causes 'Negative Population Growth' in a society?
qh: 'ऋणात्मक जनसंख्या वृद्धि' (Negative Population Growth) किस स्थिति में होती है?
o: Deaths exceed births, or substantial net out-migration occurs over a prolonged interval
Annual births precisely equal annual deaths
Total fertility rates surge past replacement levels
e: Concept: Aabadi me 'negative growth' ka matlab hai - sankhya kam hona. Ye do karano se hota hai: (1) maut (deaths) janm (births) se zyada ho jaye (budhape wale desh, jaise Japan ke kuch hisse), ya (2) bade paimane par log bahar chale jayein (net out-migration) - jaise banjara/langadhabheen ilake se sab sheher chale gaye. Dono me hisaab neeche ki taraf chalta hai. Sirf janm ghatna hi negative growth nahi, maut ka janm se zyada hona zaroori hai. Exam point: 'Negative growth = deaths > births ya bahut zyada out-migration'.

qe: What characterizes the societal dynamics in 'Stage 1' of the Demographic Transition Model?
qh: जनसांख्यिकीय संक्रमण मॉडल की 'प्रथम अवस्था' (Stage 1) की क्या विशेषता है?
o: Low fertility coupled with negligible infant mortality
Universal access to family planning and advanced medical care
Rapid industrialization with expanding life expectancies
High fluctuating birth rates balanced by high fluctuating death rates, resulting in slow population growth
e: Concept: Demographic Transition Model (DTM) me Stage 1 'high stationary' stage hota hai - yahan janm ki dar (birth rate) aur maut ki dar (death rate) dono bahut oonchi aur fluctuate karti hain, kyunki abhi dawa aur safai nahi hai. Isliye kabhi janm zyada hue to aabadi badhi, kabhi maut zyada hue to ghat gayi - net aabadi lagbhag sthir rehti hai. Aise samaaj kheti aur shikar par nirbhar hote hain. Exam point: 'DTM Stage 1 = high birth + high death = slow/slow stationary growth'.

qe: How is the 'Crude Birth Rate' (CBR) defined and expressed in demography?
qh: जनसांख्यिकी में 'अशोधित जन्म दर' (CBR) को किस प्रकार परिभाषित और व्यक्त किया जाता है?
o: Total annual live births per 100 women of childbearing age
Total infants surviving past age five per square kilometer
Ratio of male to female births multiplied by 100
Total live births in a given year per 1,000 mid-year population of an area
e: Concept: Crude Birth Rate (CBR) ek saal me paida hue jeete (live) bachchon ki sankhya hai, jise usi saal ke madhya (mid-year) ki total aabadi par nikaalte hain aur 1000 par dikhate hain. Isiliye ise 'per 1000' me likhte hain (jaise India ka CBR ~20). 'Crude' shabd isliye use hota hai kyunki isme umar/ling ka bhed (weight) nahi jodte - sirf kul aabadi se tulna karte hain. Isi tarah crude death rate bhi hota hai. Exam point: 'CBR = live births per 1000 mid-year population'.

qe: What phenomenon characterizes 'Reverse Migration' in human settlement dynamics?
qh: जनसंख्या भूगोल में 'विपरीत प्रवास' (Reverse Migration) का क्या तात्पर्य है?
o: Urban suburbanization within a single metropolitan district
Permanent oceanic migration across intercontinental shipping lines
A large-scale flow of migrants returning from urban/industrial centers back to their rural regions of origin
A seasonal circular movement of mountain herders
e: Concept: 'Reverse migration' ka matlab hai - log jo gaon se sheher ya videsh me kaam karne gaye the, wo wapas apne gaon/mool sthaan par laut aayein. Ye achhi naukri khatam hone, industry band hone ya mahamari (COVID jaisa lockdown) par bade paimane par hota hai. Isse sheher me mazdooron ki kami aur gaon me badh jati hai (aur gaon me achanak bojh badh jata hai). Exam point: 'Reverse migration = sheher se wapas gaon (na rahgarmi waapsi)'.

qe: What occurs in 'Stage 2' of the Demographic Transition Model to generate a population explosion?
qh: जनसांख्यिकीय संक्रमण मॉडल की 'द्वितीय अवस्था' (Stage 2) में जनसंख्या विस्फोट क्यों होता है?
o: Birth rates remain persistently high while death rates plunge rapidly due to medical, sanitary, and agricultural advances
Birth rates collapse while death rates double
Massive outward emigration across global borders
e: Concept: DTM ke Stage 2 ko 'Early Expanding' kehte hain - yahan maut ki dar tezi se girti hai (aspatal, dawaiyan, teeke, safai aur anaj utpadan badhne se) par janm ki dar abhi Oonchi hi rehti hai, kyunki logon ki soch aur parivar ke aakaar abhi nahi badle. Isliye tab aabadi PHATTI hai (population explosion) - India 20th sankranti me isi stage me tha. Isliye ise 'explosion stage' bhi kehte hain. Exam point: 'DTM Stage 2 = death rate girti hai, birth high = population explosion'.

qe: What demographic conditions define the 'Final Stage' (Stage 4/5) of the Demographic Transition Model?
qh: जनसांख्यिकीय संक्रमण की 'अंतिम अवस्था' (Final Stage) की क्या विशेषता है?
o: An urbanized, educated society with both low fertility and low mortality, leading to stable or contracting population numbers
High child mortality balanced by high maternal death rates
e: Concept: Demographic Transition Model ka Stage 4/5 'Low Fluctuating' hota hai - yahan janm ki dar aur maut ki dar dono KAM ho jaati hain (aur ek-doosre ke qareeb rehti hain), kyunki samaaj shehri, padha-likha aur chhote parivar wala ban jata hai. Isliye aabadi lagbhag sthir (stable) ya thodi ghaatti hui rehti hai; kuch deshon (Japan, Germany) me to aabadi ghatne lagti hai. Exam point: 'DTM Stage 4/5 = low birth + low death (stable/ghatta aabadi)'.

qe: What core argument did Thomas Robert Malthus advance in his 1798 Essay on Population?
qh: थॉमस रॉबर्ट माल्थस ने 1798 में जनसंख्या वृद्धि पर कौन सा ऐतिहासिक सिद्धांत प्रतिपादित किया था?
o: Technological innovation prevents any ecological resource limits indefinitely
Urban migration automatically stabilizes agricultural fertility rates
Agricultural output expands geometrically while population increases arithmetically
Population increases geometrically (1, 2, 4, 8, 16...) while food production increases only arithmetically (1, 2, 3, 4, 5...)
e: Concept: Thomas Robert Malthus ne 1798 me 'Essay on the Principle of Population' likha. Uska kehna tha ki aabadi jyaamitiki (geometric) tarike se badhti hai - 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 - jabki khaana sirf antmik (arithmetic) tarike se - 1, 2, 3, 4 - badhta hai. Isliye aabadi khaane se tez badhegi aur bhoookh (famine), rog aur yudh se ise rokna padega. Aaj ye theory sahi nahi nikli (technology ne khana badha diya), par 'Malthusian trap' jaisi baatein isi se aati hain. Exam point: 'Malthus = population geometric, food arithmetic'.

qe: What structural distortion occurs in destination cities like Mumbai and Delhi due to large-scale male-selective migration?
qh: मुंबई और दिल्ली जैसे महानगरों में पुरुष-प्रधान प्रवास के कारण कौन सा ढांचागत असंतुलन उत्पन्न होता है?
o: An automatic doubling of natural rural birth rates
Equalization of the municipal age pyramid across all classes
A skewed urban sex ratio resulting in a significant deficit of females relative to males in working age brackets
A complete elimination of the urban secondary labor market
e: Concept: Mumbai-Delhi jaise bade shehnon me jab gaon se zyada tar PURUSH (akela) kaam ke liye aate hain, to sheher ka linganupat (sex ratio) bigad jata hai - males ki sankhya kaam ki umar (working age) me bahut badh jaati hai aur females kam reh jaati hain. Isse mask (male) labour ke lieye makaan, kiraya, snack, transport par bojh, aur adhoora parivar jeevan (broken family life) jaisi samasyaein banti hain. Isliye ye 'skewed sex ratio' ek urban social problem hai. Exam point: 'Male-selective migration = sheher me females ki kami (skewed sex ratio)'.

qe: What is meant by the 'Demographic Dividend'?
qh: 'जनसांख्यिकीय लाभांश' (Demographic Dividend) का वास्तविक अर्थ क्या है?
o: High natural fertility rates among rural farming communities
Economic growth potential realized when the share of the working-age population (15-59) exceeds the share of dependent age cohorts
A monetary bonus distributed by census authorities
A rapid expansion in geriatric pension enrollments
e: Concept: 'Demographic Dividend' wo sunhara mauka hota hai jab kisi desh ki aabadi me kaam karne wale logon (15-59 saal) ka hissa nirbhar (badche+buzurg) logon se ZYADA ho jata hai. Is waqt kamaane wale zyada aur kharch karne wale kam hote hain, isliye bachat (savings) aur vikas tez ho jata hai - agar aabadi ko padha-likha aur kaushal (skill) wala banaya jaye. Agar naukriyan na mile vaston to yahi bada 'demographic burden' ban jata hai. India ke paas abhi yahi mauka hai. Exam point: 'Demographic dividend = working-age aabadi zyada hona = vikas ka mauka'.
